newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhenhai completes upgrading plan, lifting output.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhai completes upgrading plan, lifting output.

text.p: Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd said on Monday it had completed the early phase of an upgrading programme last December, lifting the company refining output from 5.5 million tonnes per annum to 8.0 million.
Zhenhai Refining said in a statement the 1.63 billion yuan upgrading programme also enabled the company to process up to 4 million tonnes of high sulphur-content Middle Eastern crude oil per annum.
Of the 1.63 billion yuan, some 1.5 billion came from the firm's H share offering in 1994 and the remaining amount was from Zhenhai Refining's reserve capital, it said.

The refining company also said a new expansion phase would begin this year. It was expected that the company would be able to increase its processing capacity to 12 million tonnes per annum in 2000 and to 16 million tonnes per annum in 2004.
The US$190 million expansion plan would be financed by the proceeds from the company's US$200 million convertible bonds, which were issued in December 1995.
